about.heading: Who is Dr. Elhallaj?
storyLines: My fascination with the human body made me want to become a physiotherapist,
along with a wish to help children with cerebral palsy and high-level disabilities.
I have always been interested in how the body works and repairs itself,
and how exercise and hydrotherapy can improve it.
about.text: Consultant Physical Therapist across all PT specialties, with dedicated specialization in post-operative orthopedic rehabilitation, sports injuries, and recovery protocols for optimal function and safe return to normal life and sports.

contact.heading: Ready for your first session?
contact.text: Tell him about the injury or your child's needs, and you will plan the first session together.

tools.title: Achedaway Cupping Therapy

image.alt: Two Achedaway smart cupping devices on a patient's upper back

tools.description: We use Achedaway Cupping Therapy to help relieve muscle tension, reduce discomfort, and improve local blood circulation through controlled suction. It is used as part of a recovery program to promote muscle relaxation and support overall mobility.

tools.title: Dry Needling Therapy

image.alt: Thin needles placed in the lower back muscles

tools.description: We use Dry Needling Therapy to relieve muscle pain and tension by targeting myofascial trigger points — tight, sensitive areas within the muscles that often develop due to muscular overload, repetitive strain, and intense physical training. This technique helps reduce muscle tightness, alleviate pain, and restore optimal muscle function and mobility.

tools.title: Advanced IASTM Therapy

image.alt: An IASTM tool used on the upper back

tools.description: We use Advanced IASTM Therapy with heat and vibration to relieve muscle tension, improve soft tissue mobility, reduce discomfort, and support faster recovery and optimal muscle function.

tools.title: Kinesiology Taping

image.alt: Kinesiology tape applied to a shoulder

tools.description: We use Kinesiology Taping to support muscles and joints, improve movement efficiency, and help manage pain during physical activity. The elastic therapeutic tape is applied to targeted areas to provide additional support, reduce excessive strain, and facilitate functional movement without restricting the body's natural range of motion. It can also be used as part of a comprehensive rehabilitation program to support recovery and optimize physical performance.

tools.title: Shockwave Therapy

image.alt: A shockwave applicator on a patient's shoulder

tools.description: We use Shockwave Therapy to target chronic muscle and tendon pain through focused acoustic waves, helping stimulate tissue healing, reduce discomfort, and improve mobility and functional recovery.

tools.title: Mulligan Technique

image.alt: Mulligan mobilisation of the ankle with a belt

tools.description: We use the Mulligan Technique to improve joint mobility, reduce pain, and restore normal movement through specific manual mobilization techniques combined with active patient movement.

tools.title: Electrical Stimulation Therapy

image.alt: Electrode pads on the thigh connected to a stimulation unit

tools.description: We use Electrical Stimulation Therapy to help relieve pain, stimulate muscle activity, improve circulation, and support muscle strengthening and rehabilitation.
